Utility Classes

Custom utility classes that extend the design system.

metal-tinted

Applies a shiny, slightly worn brushed-metal finish on top of the element's own background color. Set any bg-* color — the metal sheen tints to match.

Neutral metal

metal-tinted bg-neutral

Primary metal

metal-tinted bg-primary

Neon blue

metal-tinted bg-neon-blue

Neon pink

metal-tinted bg-neon-pink

Neon green

metal-tinted bg-neon-green

Gunmetal dark

metal-tinted bg-neutral

Usage

<!-- Any bg-* color works as the tint base -->
<div class="metal-tinted bg-primary rounded-lg p-6">
  Primary chrome
</div>

<div class="metal-tinted bg-neon-pink rounded-lg p-6">
  Pink chrome
</div>

The gradient and noise layers are applied via background-image and blend over the background-color, so any color utility sets the tint automatically. Bevelled inset shadows complete the metal-plate look.

text-neon

Applies a pulsating luminous neon glow to text. By default the glow color follows the text-* color. Add a shadow-* utility to decouple the glow color from the text color.

Glow follows text color

Glow decoupled from text color

Pink glow, green text

text-neon shadow-neon-pink text-neon-green

Usage

<!-- Glow follows text color -->
<span class="text-neon text-neon-blue">Glowing Blue</span>

<!-- Decouple glow from text color with shadow-* -->
<span class="text-neon shadow-neon-pink text-neon-green">
  Pink glow, green text
</span>

Without a shadow-* utility the glow uses currentColor, so text and glow are always the same hue. Add a shadow-neon-* utility to paint the glow independently. The pulsing animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.

shadow-neon

Casts an asymmetric, pulsating neon glow underneath an element. Pair with any shadow-* color utility to set the glow color independently from the text color. Falls back to currentColor when no shadow color is set.

shadow-neon shadow-neon-blue

shadow-neon shadow-neon-pink

shadow-neon shadow-neon-green

shadow-neon shadow-neon-yellow

shadow-neon shadow-neon-orange

shadow-neon shadow-neon-red

Usage

<!-- shadow-* sets the glow color independently from text color -->
<button class="shadow-neon shadow-neon-pink text-white">
  Pink glow, white text
</button>

<!-- Without shadow-*, falls back to currentColor -->
<button class="shadow-neon text-neon-blue">
  Blue glow from text color
</button>

The glow uses var(--tw-shadow-color, currentColor) so a shadow-* color utility overrides the glow color without affecting text. The pulsing animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.

inset-shadow-neon

Mirror of shadow-neon, but the glow points inward — pooling along the inside edges of the element. Designed for form fields, inset panels, and any concave surface that should look lit from within. Pair with any shadow-* color utility to set the glow color independently.

inset-shadow-neon shadow-neon-pink

inset-shadow-neon shadow-neon-green

inset-shadow-neon shadow-neon-yellow

Inset panel

inset-shadow-neon shadow-neon-orange

inset-shadow-neon shadow-neon-red

Usage

<!-- Glowing form field -->
<input class="inset-shadow-neon shadow-neon-blue rounded-md border px-3 py-2" />

<!-- Combine with shadow-neon for a bidirectional glow effect -->
<div class="inset-shadow-neon shadow-neon shadow-neon-pink">
  Glows inside and outside
</div>

Same color contract as shadow-neon — glow follows --tw-shadow-color with a currentColor fallback. The pulsing animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.

border-neon

Makes the element's border look like a neon tube — a bright hot core with a thin glass shell encasing it. The tube color follows the border-* color utility. Falls back to currentColor when no border color is set. Compose with shadow-neon to add an outward cast glow.

<!-- Tube only — border-* sets the tube color -->

</div>

<!-- Tube + outward cast glow: border-* for tube, shadow-* for glow -->

</div>

foil

Applies a holographic foil finish reminiscent of shiny trading cards — an iridescent rainbow spectrum and a sweeping metallic glare that shift as the animation plays. Works best over a solid bg-* color.

Neutral foil

foil bg-neutral

Primary foil

foil bg-primary

Neon blue foil

foil bg-neon-blue

Neon pink foil

foil bg-neon-pink

Neon green foil

foil bg-neon-green

Dark foil

foil bg-neutral

Usage

<!-- Any bg-* color works as the tint base -->
<div class="foil bg-primary rounded-lg p-6">
  Primary foil
</div>

<div class="foil bg-neon-pink rounded-lg p-6">
  Pink foil
</div>

The rainbow spectrum and glare layers are applied via background-image and blend over the background-color, so any color utility sets the underlying tint automatically. The shimmer animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.

border-foil

Renders the element's border as a shifting iridescent foil ring with a sweeping glare — the foil effect applied to a border instead of a fill. Thickness is controlled by --foil-border-width (defaults to 2px). The host does not need a Tailwind border-* utility — the ring is drawn by a pseudo-element.

Default thickness (2px)

Foil ring

border-foil bg-neon-pink

Custom thickness

1px hairline

border-foil [--foil-border-width:1px]

border-foil [--foil-border-width:4px]

8px chunky

border-foil [--foil-border-width:8px]

Composed with other effects

Foil + neon glow

border-foil shadow-neon shadow-neon-pink

Full foil card

border-foil foil bg-neutral

btn border-foil

Usage

<!-- Default 2px iridescent foil border -->
<div class="border-foil rounded-lg p-4">
  Foil ring
</div>

<!-- Custom thickness via arbitrary property -->
<div class="border-foil [--foil-border-width:4px] rounded-lg p-4">
  Thicker ring
</div>

<!-- Compose with bg-* and other effects -->
<div class="border-foil shadow-neon shadow-neon-pink bg-neutral rounded-lg p-4">
  Foil border + pink glow
</div>

The ring is painted by a ::before pseudo-element using the mask-composite "donut" technique — the inner content-box is subtracted from the full box, leaving a clean rounded ring (something border-image can't do without squaring the corners). The host's background-color and any box-shadow remain untouched, so it composes cleanly with shadow-neon, foil, and bg-* utilities. The shimmer animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.
